Advanced Data Grid

A full-featured data grid with sorting, filtering, row selection, expandable rows, pagination, column resize, frozen columns, and compact mode.

Full-Featured Grid

This grid combines sorting, selection, filtering, row expand, pagination, and toolbar actions into a single enterprise-ready component.

Features

  • Sorting — Click column headers to sort ascending/descending.
  • Column Filters — Filter inputs below headers for per-column filtering.
  • Row Selection — Checkboxes for row-level selection with select-all.
  • Expandable Rows — Click the chevron to expand row details.
  • Pagination — Client-side pagination with page info.
  • Frozen Column — Name column stays fixed when scrolling horizontally.
  • Compact Mode — Toggle between default and dense row heights.
  • Status Badges — Active (green), Inactive (gray), On Leave (yellow).
  • Toolbar — Search, department/status filters, density toggle, and export.
